name: WorkOS
tagline: Enterprise SSO, SCIM directory sync, and admin portal APIs for B2B apps.
description: WorkOS provides developer-friendly APIs for enterprise-ready authentication and user management features. Core products include Single Sign-On (SAML/OIDC), Directory Sync (SCIM), Admin Portal, Magic Auth, AuthKit, Audit Logs, and more — designed so B2B SaaS apps can offer enterprise identity features without building them from scratch.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header (sk_test_* or sk_live_* from Dashboard). Self-serve signup.

use_cases: add SAML/OIDC enterprise SSO to a B2B SaaS app
sync users and groups from customer IdPs via SCIM directory sync
embed an admin portal so customers self-configure SSO
implement passwordless magic link or AuthKit authentication
emit and query enterprise audit logs for compliance
